comparison.objective: Draft task cuts a used carton's bottom tape, opens all flaps, and collapses the intact carton; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2208 requires guarded cutting, flap acquisition, crease articulation, and whole-carton flattening; the candidate requires precision threaded tool use.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2208 proposes complete cut coverage, historical four-flap opening, intact flat geometry, parked cutter, and release; the candidate checks retained angular cycling.
comparison.reason: Cutting and folding cardboard share no meaningful tested mechanism or outcome with coupled screw–nut adjustment.
